title: Add AppUserModel_ID awareness to FancyZones
author: jsclary
summary: The unchanged upstream head, complete upstream discussion, all review pages and threads, and fork PR 336 were rechecked. The latest fork Copilot review 5100175845 matches f4d7bd38bb39d78d67ff7943cf0bab1098800661, generated zero new comments, and all three fork threads are resolved. Existing upstream comments already cover the AUMID-only-key and noexcept findings. The previous migration request is withdrawn because the author explicitly documents the one-time repositioning behavior as the compatibility tradeoff of this change; no maintainer requirement or observable current-head failure establishes legacy migration as mandatory. The fork tombstone and copy-on-removal fixes address behavior introduced by that optional fallback, not a defect in the upstream implementation. No additional nonduplicate finding is proposed.

upstream_head.detail: The exact-head focused build first failed before compiling PR code because Visual Studio 2026 is the only installed Visual Studio instance and does not include the required v143 toolset (MSB8020); the isolated tree also initially lacked restored packages. A bounded v145 fallback used the pinned package payload already present in the shared clone and progressed into native dependency compilation, then failed on absent spdlog submodule content and the old experimental-coroutine contract rejected by the v145 STL. No source was retargeted or edited. The required v143 exact-head build remains unavailable in this environment.
